status: Starting budgets, not measured capacity or universal legal limits.

ingestion.overflow_policy: quarantine_and_report; no truncation, no invented aggregate rules

retrieval.dependency_overflow_policy: return_incomplete_and_abstain_from_definitive_applicability; fetch cited text or request narrower scope
retrieval.case_binding_policy: Bind each variable to one person/vehicle/event in the query case, not just a category node. Evaluate multiple children separately; never combine age from one child with height from another. Quantified/relational facts beyond this model remain unknown until a tested evaluator is added.
retrieval.note: Post-filtering ANN top-k can lose eligible results. Use supported pre-filtering or bounded iterative overfetch; measure eligible recall. LIMIT alone does not bound traversal work.

neo4j.minimum_design_target: Neo4j 5.26 LTS; test the actual deployed version/edition before import
neo4j.id_constraint: CREATE CONSTRAINT record_id IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Record) REQUIRE n.id IS UNIQUE
neo4j.labels: Record plus exactly one concrete type; entity kinds are properties, not extra category nodes
neo4j.json_storage: Canonical UTF-8 JSON string with _json suffix. Never write a map/list-of-maps directly as a property.
neo4j.cache_policy: Generated from canonical fields only; rebuilt transactionally and not accepted as independent extraction output.
neo4j.dates: Convert ISO dates to date and timestamps to datetime through the driver. Omit null properties; keep null in exchange JSON.
neo4j.embedding_storage: Float list on Chunk; model_id, model_revision, dimension and text_sha256 in embedding cache manifest
neo4j.embedding_policy: Choose and pin an actual model before creating a vector index. Do not assume dimension=1024.
neo4j.edge_identity: Derived: digest of type/endpoints/role/var. Asserted snapshot: digest of immutable assertion payload including recorded_from, excluding id and recorded_to. Closing recorded_to never changes identity. Merge evidence for one logical assertion through audited snapshots; import idempotently by id and exact endpoints.
neo4j.transaction_policy: Validate against existing graph plus incoming batch, then atomically write nodes, relationships and scheduled validity changes. Single-writer per logical rule_key or equivalent locking required.
index_templates: CREATE INDEX rule_key IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Rule) ON (n.rule_key)
CREATE INDEX rule_valid_from IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Rule) ON (n.valid_from)
CREATE INDEX rule_recorded_from IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Rule) ON (n.recorded_from)
CREATE INDEX provision_document IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Provision) ON (n.document_id)
CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX chunk_text IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Chunk) ON EACH [n.text, n.context_text]
neo4j.note: Uniqueness does not enforce existence, endpoint types, cardinality, cycles or interval overlap. EXPLAIN/PROFILE and database integration testing are still required.

catalog_extension_policy: These are starter predicates for examples, not exhaustive traffic law. Add reviewed facts/actions with type, unit, role and tests before accepting new predicates. Unknown expressions stay text/pending_review, never silently true.
